content_units: Lisbon Dinner Fit for 12 Sep 2026, 19:30

For a group of 4 near Rossio Square, the strongest matches are   Pateo Central   and   Verde Mesa  . They best satisfy the combined priorities of cuisine fit, vegetarian coverage, shellfish avoidance, conversation comfort, walking distance, and budget.
Ranked Restaurant Comparison
Rank   Restaurant   Cuisine   Price pp   Walk from Rossio   Noise   Vegetarian Options   Fit for Your Group
1   Pateo Central   Portuguese   EUR 19-23   8 min   Moderate   3     Best overall balance  : on budget, closest, Portuguese, enough vegetarian choice, conversation-friendly enough
2   Verde Mesa   Mediterranean   EUR 20-26   10 min   Quiet   6     Best comfort/vegetarian pick  : quietest and strongest menu flexibility; slightly above budget ceiling at the top end
3   Taberna do Bairro   Portuguese tapas   EUR 18-24   12 min   Usually lively/noisy   2   Budget and distance work, but noise is a drawback for conversation
4   Casa do Fado Grill   Portuguese   EUR 22-30   14 min   Live music   1   Distance is okay, but too loud and weak for vegetarian diner; can exceed budget
5   Olive & Hearth   Mediterranean   EUR 16-22   17 min   Quiet   4   Good value and quiet, but fails the 15-minute walk limit
Why the top two win
1) Pateo Central
- Best match to your full brief, not just one criterion.
- Safely within budget for all 4.
- Shortest walk, useful for a 19:30 dinner arrival.
- Moderate noise is usually acceptable for conversation, unlike lively or live-music venues.
- Portuguese menu gives a more local experience while still offering   3 vegetarian choices  .
Pick Pateo
2) Verde Mesa
- Best if   quiet dining   and vegetarian flexibility matter most.
- Mediterranean cuisine is easy to navigate for   no shellfish  .
- 6 vegetarian options gives the group the least ordering friction.
- Only drawback: the menu may creep just over your   EUR 25 pp   ceiling if someone picks the priciest main.
Pick Verde
Best Two Picks for Your Group of 4
1) Pateo Central — Best overall recommendation
- Choose this if you want the   safest all-round fit  .
- It stays inside budget, is easy to reach, and should still be comfortable enough for group conversation.
- Better group compromise than Taberna do Bairro because it is likely less noisy.
Suggested orders for 4 diners
- Person 1: Grilled chicken with roasted potatoes and salad
- Person 2: Bacalhau-style cod dish or grilled fish, with vegetables
- Person 3: Vegetarian diner — mushroom rice, vegetable açorda, or grilled vegetable plate
- Person 4: Pork medallions or piri-piri chicken with seasonal sides
Shared starters
- Bread, olives, cheese plate
- Tomato salad or mixed vegetable soup
Shellfish-safe approach
- Avoid seafood rice, shrimp starters, shellfish broths, and mixed seafood platters
- Ask for   no shellfish cross-over on shared plates
2) Verde Mesa — Best quiet/conversation choice
- Choose this if your top priority is a   calmer meal   with easy vegetarian ordering.
- Slightly less budget-safe than Pateo Central, but still workable if mains are chosen carefully.
- Best venue if the group plans to linger and talk.
Suggested orders for 4 diners
- Person 1: Chicken souvlaki or herb-roasted chicken with rice
- Person 2: Grilled sea bass or salmon with vegetables
- Person 3: Vegetarian diner — grilled halloumi bowl, aubergine bake, falafel plate, or pasta primavera
- Person 4: Lamb kofta or Mediterranean vegetable pasta
Shared starters
- Hummus with pita
- Greek salad
- Roasted peppers or grilled courgette
Budget-safe ordering tip
- Keep mains in the   EUR 20-24   range and share 2 starters instead of 4 individual starters
Practical Dinner Plan
Best choice if you want the least risk
Pateo Central
- Strongest compliance with your stated constraints
- Best location convenience
- Easier to keep total spend predictable
Best alternative if quiet matters more than strict budget
Verde Mesa
- Better acoustics and vegetarian depth
- Still walkable
- Just watch the upper-end mains
